analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lens play at Leipzig in the Champions League on the Tuesday before, so rotation and tired legs are likely for this Saturday trip. Angers (16th) have one point from their last five league games and have struggled both at home and at defending set pieces.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I stay close to it: Angers have scored only nine all season but have conceded nine in their home games and five from set pieces, and Lens have been leaky lately. How much Lens rotate after Leipzig is the main uncertainty.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. I lean higher: per Statz Lens (5.8 a game) and Angers (6.0) are two of the top corner-winning sides in the league. Angers' weakness at defending set pieces gives Lens every reason to play for them.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. That looks fair: Angers are 15th for fouls (10.4 a game) and Lens 7th. Nothing in the news points to a bad-tempered game, so I would wait for the referee before moving it.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. I lean slightly lower: Lens average 12.9 shots a game and Angers 12.3, but Lens may rotate after Leipzig and Angers' attack has dried up. 24 or 25 looks more realistic.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. I lean lower: Angers are 17th for shots on target (3.1 a game), so most of the total has to come from Lens, who average 5.4. Eight or nine feels about right.
